canDoYue: 你識收款、講免稅，仲識包裝。
canDoEn: Take a card or cash payment, explain tax-free, and offer a bag or wrap.

dialogue.speaker: mei
dialogue.text: The total is ready, and I can read it so you can check.
dialogue.glossYue: 總數計好，我可以讀出嚟畀你對一對。
dialogue.say: The total is ready, and I can read it so you can check.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: I will pay by card, because I do not have enough cash.
dialogue.glossYue: 我會用卡付，因為現金唔夠。
dialogue.say: I will pay by card, because I do not have enough cash.

dialogue.speaker: mei
dialogue.text: This purchase is tax-free for you, so you can claim the tax.
dialogue.glossYue: 呢單係免稅，你可以申返稅。
dialogue.say: This purchase is tax-free for you, so you can claim the tax.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: Here is my passport, so you can stamp the tax-free form.
dialogue.glossYue: 護照喺度，你可以喺退稅表蓋印。
dialogue.say: Here is my passport, so you can stamp the tax-free form.

dialogue.speaker: mei
dialogue.text: I can wrap the gift and add a card if you want one.
dialogue.glossYue: 我可以包裝禮盒，如果你想要，我加張卡。
dialogue.say: I can [[ɹˈæp]] the gift and add a card if you want one.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: Could I pay with notes if the till machine is busy now?
dialogue.glossYue: 收銀機而家忙嘅話，我可唔可以用紙幣畀錢？
dialogue.say: Could I pay with notes if the till machine is busy now?

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: Could you wrap this, so I can carry it home without a bag?
dialogue.glossYue: 可唔可以包好，等我唔使袋都可以攞返屋企？
dialogue.say: Could you wrap this, so I can carry it home without a bag?

dialogue.speaker: mei
dialogue.text: Would you like to settle by phone, or would coins be easier today?
dialogue.glossYue: 你想用電話結數，定係硬幣方便啲？
dialogue.say: Would you like to settle by phone, or would coins be easier today?

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: I will settle by phone, because coins are harder when I leave.
dialogue.glossYue: 我會用電話付，因為銀仔難帶。
dialogue.say: I will settle by phone, because coins are harder when I leave.

dialogue.speaker: mei
dialogue.text: Here is your receipt, which you should keep with the slip.
dialogue.glossYue: 呢張收據你要留低，同一張單。
dialogue.say: Here is your [[ɹɪsˈit]], which you should keep with the slip.

dialogue.speaker: mei
dialogue.text: Sign the refund form if you want the tax back.
dialogue.glossYue: 如果你想攞返稅，請喺退稅表簽名。
dialogue.say: Sign the [[ɹˈifˌʌnd]] form if you want the tax back.

understand.prompt: Would you like to pay by card? 即係問緊咩？
understand.explain: pay by card 係用卡付款。現金先至係 cash。

understand.prompt: This purchase is tax-free. 呢句即係點？
Here is your receipt. 你遞畀客人？
understand.explain: receipt 重音喺第二節。發票先至係 invoice。

chunks.pattern: Would you like to pay by ___, or is cash easier for you today?
chunks.example: Would you like to pay by card, or is cash easier for you today?

chunks.pattern: This purchase is ___, so you can claim the tax later.
chunks.example: This purchase is tax-free, so you can claim the tax later.

chunks.pattern: Here is your ___, and please keep it with you until you leave today.
chunks.example: Here is your receipt, and please keep it with you until you leave today.

chunks.pattern: Could you ___ the gift so I can carry it home today?
chunks.example: Could you wrap the gift so I can carry it home today?
chunks.glossYue: 可唔可以⋯⋯份禮物，等我今日帶得返屋企？

build.promptYue: Tom 想用現金。你點問卡？
choices: Would you like to pay by card?

roleplay.intro: Tom 喺櫃檯準備付款。等佢講完先答。免稅要睇護照。

turns.expect: Would you like to pay by card?

quiz.prompt: 客人講「This purchase is tax-free for you, so you can claim the tax.」，係咩意思？
客人講「I can wrap the gift and add a card if you want one.」，係咩意思？

sound.title: 拍卡入面嗰個音
sound.note: contactless 有 /l/。舌尖抵住上顎後面，氣由兩邊出。cash 尾係 /ʃ/，唔好讀成 /s/。receipt 重音喺第二節。wrap 開頭唔出聲。
